## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 10, 2026 - Oct 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Alek Comstock_, Oct 17, 2026, 1/5: "can't activate guest pass to let guest in. made sure app is updated too. new app has too much scrolling and clicking for what's suppose to be a quick check in, sometimes having slow loading times on top of that."
            2. _Terry Lycans_, Oct 16, 2026, 1/5: "Edit 14Oct26: the year to date check-in display is still broken. The latest update increased the number of 2026 check-ins but it's frozen at 240. I've visited PF at least 260 days this year. New app is a train wreck. It now no longer closes via back button, has deleted months of check-ins/activities, and is a cluttered, confusing mess. Activity tracking is terrible, with tons of equipment missing and no search feature. A perfectly functional app was just destroyed...who greenlit this mess?"
            3. _AJey Calloway_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "I'm completely over this app. I joined Planet Fitness 2 weeks ago and still have not been able to get this app to work. I tried logging in half a dozen times and it freezes. I've only been able to successfully login 1 time and even then it never gave to QR code so that I can scan everytime I enter Planet Fitness. I'm sooo over this and it's just frustrating. Even the team members that work there couldn't figure out why this is happening."
<!--/ir-theme-->
